title: Publish your apps
summary: Put your apps on the web for anyone to use, and set up the agent browser from anywhere.

highlights.title: Publish apps to the web
highlights.body: Publish an app on matrix.page with one control. Each publish is versioned, and visitors can submit forms that save back to you.

items.text: Set up the agent browser from any OS view.
Connecting Claude with an Anthropic API key works again.
Saved Codex connections recover on their own.
Owners can delete shared projects again.
Bot recipes and older chats run again.
The onboarding prompt no longer covers full-screen project chats.
